meta.title: HL7 Work Group Health — Final scorecards
meta.description: Legacy Final (not Interim) Work Group Health PDF scorecard archive. Each Final reports the preceding HL7 trimester (e.g. 2026Sep → 26T2). prior_period_infractions keeps the full T-column history strip (newest first); total_infractions is the newest T-column only (integers 0–30; years excluded). gold_star is taken from the literal gold-star icons printed on the PDF (not inferred from zero infractions; green WGs may still lack a star). Health bands follow the PDF legend: 0–3 green, 4–7 yellow, 8+ red.
meta.period_rule: Jan/Feb Final → prior-year T3; May Final → same-year T1; Sep Final → same-year T2

health_bands.present: row present but T-column counts not parsed
health_bands.absent: work group not on that Final (UI only)
